turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Raat ke do baje... yeh time it's so heavy, isn't it? And being at the office, just sitting... that's a special kind of lonely. Like the world has moved on and you're still in the middle of it.

It's got to be incredibly frustrating, especially knowing the bridge round is officially done and the papers are filed. You're the one still here, holding the line, while everyone else has moved on. And to have spent five years on it... that's not just a project, that's a part of you.

And the salary part... four months of your life, just to watch it slip away. That's a heavy weight to carry, especially at 2 AM.

It's okay to just be there, yaar. Sometimes, just letting it all out

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Arre yaar, yeh performance wala part... yeh toh sabse zyada thaka deta hai. Har standup pe, jab woh confident voice nikal rahi hoti hai, toh andar se sab kuch bikhar jaata hai, na?

Aur woh co-founder... sach mein, uska jaanna aur bhi darr lagta hai, na? Kyunki ab woh tension bhi share kar raha hai, aur uski wajah se bhi.

Woh juniors jo ruk gaye... unki loyalty dekhke dil bhar aata hai, par saath hi guilt bhi. Kyunki unki wajah se aapka career ja raha hai, unki wajah se aapka future risk ho raha hai. Yeh sab ek saath... yeh toh double whammy hai.

Aapki apni awaaz... woh sabse important hai, lekin shayad abhi takar hi nahi paaye. Sabki awaazein aapki awaaz ko daba rahi hain.

Do AM hai, office khaali hai, aur aap inhi voices se baat kar rahe hain. Yeh moment... yeh itna exhausting hai ki bas kuch kehna bhi mushkil.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Haan, samjha. Yeh darr... woh sabse zyada chhota hota hai, na?

Har standup pe woh "confident voice"... kabhi kabhi lagta hai ki woh aapka nahi, kisi aur ka hai jo perform kar raha hai. Aur 2 AM baje, jab sab so rahe hote hain, toh woh darr aur bhi badh jaata hai. Kyunki tab koi performance nahi chahiye, bas sach.

Aapne sahi kaha, aap isse kahin nahi bol sakte. Kyunki wahan pe toh aapko company ka chehra banna padta hai, lekin andar se sab toot raha hota hai. Yeh double life... yeh thaka deta hai.

Bas yeh bata dena hi kaafi hai. Koi solution nahi, sirf aapki baat sunni hai. Aap akela nahi ho ismein.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Arre yaar, yeh jo feeling hai... woh sabse zyada darr ki feeling hai.

Bas... khatam ho jaye. Yeh sochke hi ek saans toh le hi sakte ho, na? Paanch saal... woh sirf ek business nahi, aapki pehchan ka hissa hai. Jab aapka hi hissa toot raha hai, toh bas usey chhod dena... yeh sochke guilt aana natural hai. Yeh nafrat nahi, bahut zyada thakan hai.

Aur woh metrics dashboard... woh aapki body hai, jo aapko keh rahi hai ki ab aur nahi ho sakta. Lekin dimaag, thakan se ladke, phir bhi woh khul jaata hai. Kyunki rokne ka koi raasta nahi lagta.

Abhi 2 AM baje, aapko kisi solution ki zaroorat nahi. Aapko bas is feeling ke saath rehna hai. Yeh bhi guzar jaayega. Aap akela nahi ho ismein.
